# Synthetic request REQ-001: pause exports

Operators need to pause exports without changing authentication.

- While exports are disabled, an authorized export request returns 503 with
  code EXPORTS_DISABLED and does not invoke the exporter.
- While exports are enabled, existing export behavior is unchanged.
- An unauthorized request never invokes the exporter.

Out of scope: any new identity provider or network integration.

This is a synthetic fixture. It is not a real ticket.
